subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should plugin Control UI entry points be restricted to in-app opaque-origin iframes for the first SDK surface, or may plugins request same-window/new-window UI with a separate isolation design?
rationale: This PR creates a new public plugin SDK and browser-auth surface; the safe trust boundary is a product/security decision, not only a mechanical TypeScript fix.

options.title: Restrict first release to opaque in-app iframes
options.body: Remove or reject same-window/new-window modes, force plugin entry iframes to a fixed opaque sandbox, update docs/tests, and require exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Design separate isolation for wider modes
options.body: Keep the PR paused until same-window/new-window plugin UI has a maintainer-approved separate-origin, CSP, or equivalent browser isolation model.

options.title: Decline this SDK shape for now
options.body: Close or supersede this branch if maintainers want Control UI plugin contributions to stay descriptor-only or route through the broader RFC first.

recommendation.title: Restrict first release to opaque in-app iframes
recommendation.body: Remove or reject same-window/new-window modes, force plugin entry iframes to a fixed opaque sandbox, update docs/tests, and require exact-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the related generic host-hook foundation and the broader Control UI plugin contribution-slots RFC most directly tied to this API shape.
